definition: A neurological syndrome characterized by the prominent co-occurrence of cerebellar ataxia with lower-limb spasticity and other pyramidal features, often representing an overlapping phenotype on the spectrum between hereditary ataxias and hereditary spastic paraplegias.

source.title: A diagnostic approach to spastic ataxia syndromes
source.quote: Spastic ataxia is characterized by the combination of cerebellar ataxia with spasticity and other pyramidal features.
